content_text:
Cadets - Victoria
About Erilyan
Operating across Australia, Erilyan delivers the critical projects that shape Australia's future, projects that demand precision, reliability, and true partnership. With a team of more than 200 professionals, we specialise in Australia's critical sectors including healthcare, data centres, commercial, and other complex environments. We partner with clients who value collaboration, transparency, and a commitment to excellence, working together to deliver when it matters, The Erilyan Way.
The Opportunity
We’re growing, and we’re looking for multiple Cadets to join our teams in Victoria. This is a hands-on role designed for people who want to learn construction from the inside. You’ll gain real experience across the different fields of construction, supported by experienced professionals who will help you build your skills and your career. Interviews will take place in November and December, with a start date of 27 January 2027.
In this role you will:
- Rotate through contract administration, site administration and coordination, engineering, preconstruction and estimating
- Support project teams with document control, procurement, RFIs, variations, programming and cost reporting
- Get on site to attend meetings, complete site diaries, log deliveries and carry out inspections and progress photos
- Contribute to safety and quality processes, including site inductions, toolbox talks and HSEQ inspections
- Use industry software such as Jobpac, CostX, Procore and EstimateOne
Why Join Erilyan
- Competitive salaries with annual reviews.
- A structured capability framework to guide your progression.
- Paid parental leave.
- Four Wellbeing Days + Birthday Leave. *
- Training, mentoring, and leadership programs.
- Opportunities to contribute to community and charity initiatives like ReLove.
- A people-focused culture that recognises and celebrates your achievements.
About You
- Currently studying or have recently finished a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, WHS, or a related field
- Strong attention to detail and a confident communicator
- Basic understanding of construction plans (or a keen interest to learn)
- Takes ownership of tasks, and values constructive feedback. 
Our Brand Values
Genuine, Progressive, Effective. At Erilyan, we’re upfront, innovative, and get the job done to the highest standard.  If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a supportive, high-performing team, apply now and start building your future with us.
*Subject to eligibility
Erilyan have preferred suppliers in place and do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies.
